title: NFL Football
description:
Minnesota Vikings at Green Bay Packers
The Green Bay Packers host the Minnesota Vikings in an NFC North rivalry game at Lambeau Field. Minnesota has won four of the last five meetings, including a 39-22 win at U.S. Bank Stadium earlier this season, and Green Bay looks to even the series.

title: NFL Football
description:
San Francisco 49ers at Dallas Cowboys
The Dallas Cowboys host the San Francisco 49ers in NFL regular-season play at AT&T Stadium. San Francisco is tied with Buffalo for the league's best record at 7-1, while Dallas would love to even its record at 5-5 with an upset victory.
